title: 2003 HMMT February Guts Problem 19
statement: Let \(r, s, t\) be the solutions to the equation \(x^{3}+a x^{2}+b x+c=0\). What is the value of \((r s)^{2}+(s t)^{2}+(r t)^{2}\) in terms of \(a, b\), and \(c\) ?

solutions.text:
\(b^{2}-2 a c\)
We have \((x-r)(x-s)(x-t)=x^{3}+a x^{2}+b x+c\), so

\[a=-(r+s+t), \quad b=r s+s t+r t, \quad c=-r s t .\]

So we have

\[(r s)^{2}+(s t)^{2}+(r t)^{2}=(r s+s t+r t)^{2}-2 r s t(r+s+t)=b^{2}-2 a c .\]
